thread:
alex: Quick checkpoint on the postmortem actions from yesterday's incident. I split the list into three lanes: infra blockers, rollout/process, and monitoring/alerts. Need owners + ETA for items 2, 4, and 7.
maria: I'm happy to own infra blockers 1 & 2. For #2 (autoscale backoff tuning) I can take a first pass — ETA EOD Thu. :calendar:
jon: I'll take rollout/process #4 (canary rollback runbook updates). Planning to push draft tomorrow AM and link the PR.
sam: Monitoring/alerts #7 (alert thresholds + noise filtering) — I need one dependency: metrics-lib bump to include new histograms. ETA Fri if dependency lands.
alex: thanks. @sam what's the blocker for metrics-lib bump? small change or needs cross-team review?
sam: it's a small change but across teams. pinged infra-lib-team yesterday, no reply yet. @Priya (oncall) any recommended contacts?
Priya (oncall): @sam ping @infra-lib-team lead, they usually respond to a direct mention. If still stuck, escalate to @maria.
jon: FYI I found a tiny ambiguity in the rollback runbook: step 3 doesn't mention KV cache clear. I'll add note and a one-liner command.
alex: include the exact command in the PR, e.g.:
```
# clear model kv cache on nodes matching tag
ssh infra-node-01
sudo /usr/local/bin/redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 FLUSHDB
```
maria: noted. For autoscale backoff (#2) I'll include the simulation outputs in the PR so we can see latency tradeoffs.
jon: also tagging @security to review canary permission matrix; adding a checklist to the PR.
sam: metrics-lib lead replied — can do the bump but needs compat test added. I'll slot that in and aim to have tests by Thu morning.
alex: OK timeline check: maria EOD Thu, jon PR tomorrow AM, sam tests Thu morning -> can we target next Mon for closing all three items?
Priya (oncall): that seems reasonable. I'll mark the incident tracker with those ETAs and flag for a quick 15min sync Fri if anything slips.
alex: perfect. last ask — please add the action item number in the PR title, e.g., "POSTMORTEM-#4 canary rollback runbook" so Ops can link it.
maria: will do.
jon: done, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runs/12345 — includes runbook update + checklist.
sam: will add tests and link metrics PR to that.
alex: thanks everyone. I'll close this thread after I update the tracker. :thumbsup:
